sets.title: Pick the Preposition
sets.description: Choose через, назад, за, or на for each time context

items.prompt: Самолёт вылетает _____ два часа. (The plane departs in two hours.)
items.promptEnglish: The plane departs in two hours. (future time point)
items.explanation: Через два часа: in two hours (from now). Future time reference.

items.prompt: Она прочитала роман _____ три дня. (She read the novel in three days.)
items.promptEnglish: She read the novel in three days. (completed within that time)
items.hint: Completed within a timeframe = за + accusative.
items.explanation: За три дня: within/in three days (the reading was completed).

items.prompt: Мы приехали сюда _____ неделю. (We came here for a week.)
items.promptEnglish: We came here for a week. (planned duration of stay)
items.explanation: На неделю: for a week (our planned stay).

items.prompt: Это случилось пять лет _____. (This happened five years ago.)
items.explanation: Пять лет назад: five years ago. Назад always follows the time phrase.

items.prompt: Я вернусь _____ десять минут. (I'll be back in ten minutes.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll be back in ten minutes. (future)
items.explanation: Через десять минут: in ten minutes from now.

items.prompt: Он сделал всю работу _____ час. (He did all the work in an hour.)
items.promptEnglish: He did all the work in/within an hour. (completed)
items.explanation: За час: within an hour (the work was finished).

items.prompt: Она уехала в командировку _____ две недели. (She went on a business trip for two weeks.)
items.promptEnglish: She went on a business trip for two weeks. (duration)
items.explanation: На две недели: for two weeks (planned length of trip).

minimalPairs.context: Я сделаю это _____ час. (I'll do it within one hour - I'll finish.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'll complete it within an hour.
minimalPairs.explanation: За час = within/in the span of an hour (completed). Focus on finishing within the time.

minimalPairs.context: Я позвоню _____ час. (I'll call in one hour - from now.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'll call in an hour (one hour from now).
minimalPairs.explanation: Через час = in an hour (from now). A future time point, not a duration.

minimalPairs.context: Он уехал _____ месяц. (He left for a month - planned stay.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He left for a month (he plans to be away a month).
minimalPairs.explanation: На месяц = for a month (intended duration of absence).

minimalPairs.context: Он выучил язык _____ месяц. (He learned the language in a month.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He learned the language in a month (achieved it within a month).
minimalPairs.explanation: За месяц = in/within a month (the learning was completed in that time).

sets.title: Transform and Translate
sets.description: Rewrite with different time prepositions and translate
sets.descriptionRussian: Перестройте предложения и переведите с английского

translation.prompt: The exam is in three days.
translation.explanation: Через три дня: in three days from now.
Десять лет назад: ten years ago. Назад follows the time phrase.

translation.answer: Она приготовила ужин за тридцать минут.
translation.explanation: За тридцать минут: within 30 minutes (dinner was ready).

translation.prompt: He went abroad for six months.
translation.answer: Он уехал за границу на шесть месяцев.
translation.explanation: На шесть месяцев: for six months (planned stay abroad).

blanks: Магазин закроется _____ двадцать минут. (The store closes in twenty minutes.)
Они переехали _____ год. (They moved a year ago.)
Она выучила стихотворение _____ вечер. (She memorized the poem in one evening.)
explanations: Через двадцать минут: in twenty minutes (from now).
Год назад: a year ago. Назад follows the time phrase.
За вечер: in/within one evening (she finished memorizing).

items.text: Он написал письмо за пять минут.
Он собрал вещи за десять минут.
Я взял книгу на два дня.

errorCorrection.hint: Future time point = через, not за.
errorCorrection.explanation: Через два часа: in two hours (from now). За would mean 'within two hours' (completion).

errorCorrection.hint: Ago = time + назад. Without назад, через means 'in (future).'
errorCorrection.explanation: Она уехала неделю назад (a week ago). Через неделю means 'in a week' (future).

errorCorrection.hint: Completed within = за. На = for (intended duration of stay).
errorCorrection.explanation: За год: within a year (he learned/completed). На год would mean 'for a year' (planned stay).

errorCorrection.hint: For (planned duration) = на. За = completed within.
errorCorrection.explanation: На две недели: for two weeks (planned stay). За would mean 'within two weeks' (time to complete something).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All four time prepositions in tricky contexts
sets.descriptionRussian: Все четыре временных предлога в сложных контекстах

items.prompt: Я прочитаю эту книгу _____ выходные. (I'll read this book over the weekend.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll read this book over the weekend. (finish it within)
items.hint: Completed within = за. The goal is to finish.
items.explanation: За выходные: within/over the weekend (I'll finish reading).

items.prompt: Они встретились _____ и сразу подружились. (They met long ago and immediately became friends.)
items.hint: Long ago = давно (not *долго назад). Давно is the standard word.
items.explanation: Давно: long ago. Russian uses давно, not *долго назад (which is a common foreigner error).

items.prompt: Мы остановились в гостинице _____ три ночи. (We checked into a hotel for three nights.)
items.promptEnglish: We stayed at a hotel for three nights. (planned stay)
items.explanation: На три ночи: for three nights (our planned stay).

items.prompt: Урок закончится _____ сорок минут. (The class ends in forty minutes.)
items.promptEnglish: The class ends in forty minutes. (future time point)
items.explanation: Через сорок минут: in 40 minutes from now.

items.prompt: Она научилась водить машину _____ месяц. (She learned to drive in a month.)
items.promptEnglish: She learned to drive in a month. (completed)
items.hint: Learned (completed) within a time period = за.
items.explanation: За месяц: within a month (the learning was completed).

items.prompt: Эти события произошли много веков _____. (These events happened many centuries ago.)
items.promptEnglish: These events happened many centuries ago.
items.explanation: Много веков назад: many centuries ago.

patternRecognition.sentence: Я сделаю это через час. / Я сделаю это за час.
patternRecognition.question: What is the difference?
options: Through = I'll start in an hour; за = I'll finish within an hour
Through is formal, за is informal
patternRecognition.answer: Through = I'll start in an hour; за = I'll finish within an hour
patternRecognition.explanation: Через час: I'll do it in an hour (future starting point). За час: I'll do it within an hour (completion time).

patternRecognition.sentence: Она приехала на неделю. / Она приехала неделю назад.
patternRecognition.question: What is the difference?
options: First = she arrived for a week (planned stay); second = she arrived a week ago (time reference)
First is future, second is past
patternRecognition.answer: First = she arrived for a week (planned stay); second = she arrived a week ago (time reference)
patternRecognition.explanation: На неделю: for a week (how long she plans to stay). Неделю назад: a week ago (when she arrived).

blanks: Автобус будет _____ пять минут. (The bus comes in five minutes.)
Он приехал в гости _____ пару дней. (He came to visit for a couple of days.)
explanations: Через пять минут: in five minutes from now.
На пару дней: for a couple of days (visit duration).
